sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hol*? asks where. For this unit, use *lakom* to say where you live.

Notice that Budapest doesn’t stay bare — it becomes Budapesten, picking up an ending that actually means ‘on,’ not ‘in.’ Budapest is one of a handful of Hungarian place names that take this ‘on’ ending instead of the more common ‘in’ ending most other cities use (Londonban, Hanoiban) — an idiosyncrasy that just has to be memorized city by city. For now, just memorize Budapesten lakom as a fixed chunk, and you’re already saying something true about yourself.
